description: This PHP source file defines the ClientRepository class, which implements OAuth client management functionalities for the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve OAuth client entities, validate client credentials, and ensure security compliance within the OAuth authentication flow.

classes.name: ClientRepository
classes.description: A repository class handling OAuth client data operations, including retrieval and validation, within the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin.

methods.name: getOAuthClientById
methods.description: Private method to retrieve an OAuth client entity by its identifier, ensuring it is enabled.

methods.name: getClientEntity
methods.description: Retrieves a client entity by its identifier and returns it as a ClientEntityInterface object, or null if not found.

methods.name: validateClient
methods.description: Validates client credentials and grant type, including secret verification for confidential clients.

methods.name: validateClientSecret
methods.description: Private method to verify the client secret against the stored hash using PasswordHash utility.
